test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The full form of IRDAI is:

options.text: International Relations Development Authority of India
Irrigation and Rural Development Authority of India
Insurance Regulation and Developmental Authority of India
Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** is the regulatory body in India that oversees the insurance industry.
 
• IRDAI was constituted by an act of parliament known as the **IRDA Act, 1999**.
 
• The primary purpose of IRDAI is to protect the interests of policyholders and ensure the growth of the insurance sector.
 
• IRDAI also aims to promote and regulate the orderly growth of the insurance industry in India.
 
• The headquarters of IRDAI is located in **Hyderabad, Telangana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act** was passed by the Indian Parliament in 1999, and the authority was established in 2000.
 
• The IRDAI is responsible for the regulation, promotion, and ensuring the orderly growth of the insurance and re-insurance business in India.
 
• It also sets norms and regulations for the conduct of insurance companies and intermediaries.
 
• IRDAI plays a crucial role in ensuring financial stability and consumer protection within the insurance sector.
 
• The authority is composed of a chairman and not more than nine members, of whom at least five are full-time members.
